title: Household Members
question: Who shares your home environment?
subtitle: Helps ensure the breed's natural temperament is a great match for your household dynamics.

options.label: Adults only (no kids or other pets)
options.desc: Calm, quiet living environment with adult companions.

options.label: Household with children
options.desc: Needs a gentle, patient, and child-tolerant breed.

options.label: Living with other pets (dogs, cats, etc.)
options.desc: Requires a sociable breed adaptable to multi-pet dynamics.

options.label: Active family with both kids and pets
options.desc: Needs a highly resilient, confident, and social temperament.

title: Living Space
question: What type of home do you live in?
subtitle: Some breeds thrive indoors in compact spaces, while others appreciate more vertical room.

options.label: Apartment or condo
options.desc: Compact indoor living; suited for cats comfortable in smaller footprints.

options.label: Single-family home or townhouse
options.desc: Spacious living environment with multiple rooms to explore.

title: Activity Level
question: What cat energy level best fits your daily routine?
subtitle: From peaceful, serene lap cats to athletic acrobats seeking interactive playtime.

options.label: Calm & gentle lap companion
options.desc: Prefers relaxed napping, gentle affection, and low-key companionship.

options.label: Balanced & adaptable
options.desc: Enjoys short play sessions interspersed with peaceful lounging.

options.label: High energy & playful explorer
options.desc: Loves interactive toys, high perches, and energetic agility games.

title: Grooming & Coat Care
question: How much grooming care can you commit to each week?
subtitle: Coat maintenance directly impacts loose hair, surface dander, and bathing needs.

options.label: Low maintenance (quick weekly brush)
options.desc: Minimal coat upkeep with low shed or naturally short fur.

options.label: Moderate care (1-2 weekly brushings)
options.desc: Comfortable maintaining dense fur to trap and remove dander.

options.label: Hands-on care (frequent brushing or skin baths)
options.desc: Willing to do thorough triple-coat brushing or routine hairless skin care.

title: Adoption & Care Budget
question: What is your target budget tier for adoption and initial care?
subtitle: Hypoallergenic purebreds from certified catteries vary in adoption fees and specialty care.

options.label: $$ — Moderate ($1,000 – $1,800)
options.desc: Standard purebred adoption or established rescue programs.

options.label: $$$ — Mid-to-High ($1,800 – $3,000)
options.desc: Dedicated low-allergen lines or pedigree registered kittens.

options.label: $$$$ — Specialty / Premium ($3,000+)
options.desc: Rare lines, specialized health screening, or hairless pedigrees.

options.label: Flexible / Budget is not a primary constraint
options.desc: Prioritize breed compatibility and allergen profile above upfront cost.

title: Vocalization & Independence
question: What is your preference for alone-time and vocalization?
subtitle: Some cats are quiet and self-reliant; others thrive on conversational chirps and constant company.

options.label: Quiet & independent
options.desc: Rarely meows, calm during work hours, peaceful demeanor.

options.label: Social & balanced
options.desc: Greets you warmly at the door, content while you work.

options.label: Very talkative & companion-seeking
options.desc: Enjoys chatting, follows you from room to room, thrives on attention.
